mapper.insert: insert into other_work_details ( work_id, start_time, end_time, break_minutes, description ) values ( #{workId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{breakMinutes}, #{description} )
mapper.update: update other_work_details set start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, break_minutes = #{breakMinutes}, description = #{description} where work_id = #{workId}
